variant.author: SalvatoreDevelopment
variant.changelog: Added new filters to randomly select jobs by role or group (support or dps).
variant.description:
In-game radio streaming for Final Fantasy XIV. Enter a stream URL and listen to your favorite radio! Features external plugin integration for Umbra widgets and other plugins via reflection.

Note: AetherFM is only supported on Windows. Due to its reliance on the NAudio library, audio playback is not available on Linux or non-Windows versions of Dalamud.

variant.author: SalvatoreDevelopment
variant.changelog:
v1.2.0: IPC gates, Global search, Custom Stations, background playback, robustness.
- Formal IPC call gates (incl. ResumeLast, TogglePlayStop); non-throw policy; ordered events
- Global search (name/tag/language) and Custom Stations (add/list/remove)
- Favorites enhancements (names API), favorites always visible
- More stations: limit=10000, hide broken, clickcount order; wider stream validation (http/https,/stream, mp3/aac)
- Background playback toggle (ON by default): stop on close only if disabled
